title: Replace the Beams with Rotten Timbers
era: End of Qin · about 2,200 years ago

source.chapter: Replace the Beams with Rotten Timbers
source.quote: Change his formation again and again, draw off his picked troops; wait for him to fall apart on his own, then ride it. This is to drag his wheels.

moral: Swap the key post; the rest still stand, and nothing looks changed.
transfer: Change the key step to change the habit.
